title: Blockstream Executive Peter Bain: Institutional Clients Say Bitcoin “Poised for a Big Bull Run”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Blockstream Executive Peter Bain: Institutional Clients Say Bitcoin “Poised for a Big Bull Run” Blockstream CMO Peter Bain explains why holding $81K signals strength, the push into Swiss institutional banking, and the latest Liquid Network recovery. This post Blockstream Executive Peter Bain: Institutional Clients Say Bitcoin “Poised for a Big Bull Run” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
